name: Alfian Aditya Kurniawan
headline: Software Engineer
intro: I build software end to end — web platforms and SaaS, AI-powered features, and real-time 3D apps and games in Unity and Unreal Engine.

about.lead: Web platforms, AI features and real-time 3D — designed and built end to end.
paragraphs: At PT Molca Teknologi Nusantara I developed Unity-based Digital Twin applications for Molca Factory, PLN PLTU Labuan, Petrokimia Gresik, Nusametal Astra Otoparts and PT AlamTri Resources Indonesia, a hardware-integrated Safety Driving Simulator for PetroChina International Jabung, and Savior VR: Arecaverse, an immersive safety-training application.

Alongside that, I design and develop full-stack products at FORTA Technology — a SaaS platform with centralized administration and CMS, a company profile with an administrative dashboard, and point-of-sale applications.
My final project at PENS was a hybrid cloud-local AI virtual assistant connecting Unreal Engine 5 to a Python server, reaching 95% BERT intent-classification accuracy.
